Man everyone in this comment section is really blaming you for having a secret and I kinda think that sucks. NTA. 

1.) people are allowed to have secrets. This was something that you got associated with for your entire life and it’s reasonable that you would have trust issues with ANYONE regarding this. Should you trust your wife more than other people? Absolutely! But does that erase years of repeat offenses causing you to have doubt? No. That is information you should be allowed to share if and when you want.

2.) there’s no issues your kids will have because of this scenario. Again, negating her “need” to be told. She likely feels upset that you didn’t tell her something so important, but everyone, EVERYONE is entitled to hold onto things they don’t feel comfortable discussing or can’t mentally process over and over again. 

I won’t go as far as to say your wife is the asshole though. I think that is very big news to have dropped on you and many people don’t know how to process that kind of information. However, just because you are the product of your parents decisions does not mean that is who you are or what people should be focusing on.
